review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR and a second production run of cs_app::scenario_control::survey_scenario_control_programs over the installation (scenario-control-census.json). Claim is implemented only. MEASURED: every mission-scoped reader archive was opened through production discovery, every member decoded with the production .zrd reader, and each archive declaring no numbered OBJECTIVE<N> block located its control member by a contents rule — the unique member whose decoded record declares the measured scenario descriptor (a mission_type field, F42-A's grammar) — with zero candidates a measured absence and two a refusal. Of 53 mission-scoped readers, 40 carry a block-bearing control member (the mission population, counted but not re-measured) and 13 are scenarios: 8 declare exactly one descriptor member and 5 declare none (zbd/c1/mp3, zbd/c2b/mp3, zbd/c5/mp1, zbd/c5/mp2, zbd/c5/mp3) — the multiplayer readers, whose control data is the different, thinner surface this census measures beside the absence: the record-level objectives.zrd keys (vocabulary EXECUTE_ANIMS (11 row(s)), INVALIDATE_ANIMS (11 row(s)), MISSION_TIMER (13 row(s)), OBJECTIVE_DELAY (2 row(s)), PLAYER_INIT (11 row(s)), PLAY_LOSS_ANIM_WHEN_MAVERICK_ON_RUNWAY (2 row(s)), READ_TIME (2 row(s)), RESTORE_ANIMS (11 row(s)), REVIEW_DELAY (2 row(s)); spellings outside the measured record vocabulary: OBJECTIVE_DELAY, PLAY_LOSS_ANIM_WHEN_MAVERICK_ON_RUNWAY, READ_TIME, REVIEW_DELAY), the bare net.zrd spawn-point list (every net.zrd in the installation parses as the measured four-float shape: zbd/c1/m02: 8 entries; zbd/c1/m04: 8 entries; zbd/c1/m05: 8 entries; zbd/c1/mp1: 80 entries; zbd/c1/mp2: 48 entries; zbd/c1/mp3: 48 entries; zbd/c1b/m03: 8 entries; zbd/c1b/mp1: 80 entries; zbd/c1b/mp3: 48 entries; zbd/c1c/m01: 8 entries; zbd/c1c/mp1: 80 entries; zbd/c1c/mp3: 48 entries; zbd/c2/m01: 8 entries; zbd/c2/m02: 8 entries; zbd/c2/m03: 8 entries; zbd/c2/m05: 8 entries; zbd/c2/mp1: 80 entries; zbd/c2/mp2: 48 entries; zbd/c2/mp3: 48 entries; zbd/c2b/m04: 8 entries; zbd/c2b/mp1: 80 entries; zbd/c2b/mp3: 48 entries; zbd/c3/m01: 8 entries; zbd/c3/m02: 8 entries; zbd/c3/m03: 8 entries; zbd/c3/m04: 8 entries; zbd/c3/m05: 8 entries; zbd/c3/mp1: 80 entries; zbd/c3/mp2: 48 entries; zbd/c3/mp3: 48 entries; zbd/c4/m01: 0 entries; zbd/c4/m02: 0 entries; zbd/c4/m03: 0 entries; zbd/c4/m04: 0 entries; zbd/c4/m05: 0 entries; zbd/c4/mp1: 80 entries; zbd/c4/mp2: 48 entries; zbd/c4/mp3: 48 entries; zbd/c5/m01: 0 entries; zbd/c5/m02: 0 entries; zbd/c5/m03: 0 entries; zbd/c5/m04: 0 entries; zbd/c5/mp1: 80 entries; zbd/c5/mp2: 48 entries; zbd/c5/mp3: 48 entries) and the objective-marked targets.zrd records. No campaign-mission reader anywhere declares a descriptor member (is empty). LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED, each recorded in docs/findings/2026-10-13-m01-lc-scenarios.md: (1) what the files DECLARE is measured and what any declaration DOES is not — no original executable has been run, so a scenario mode, a spawn coordinate and an objective marker are spellings, never observed behaviour; (2) the fourth number of a spawn entry, the meaning of a scenario mode and the rule by which a multiplayer objective completes are unmeasured; (3) zeppelins.zrd records are counted only — their field vocabulary stays F35's and T574's measurement; (4) an instant-action or multiplayer scenario is not a campaign mission: this census never widens the mission denominator and lowers nothing to a MissionProgram. `unknowns` is empty because every unresolved item above is a limit on the claim rather than an unresolved measurement: every archive either located its control surface or was named as declaring none. TEST-SELECTION NOTE: the prefix accept_m01_lc_scenarios_ is unique to this task's file, so this run's 7 discovered assertions are exactly this task's.
